name: Hereditary Sensory and Autonomic Neuropathy Type 1

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for HSAN Type 1

criteria.description: Progressive distal sensory loss predominantly affecting pain and temperature modalities
Signs of autonomic dysfunction including anhidrosis and orthostatic hypotension
Recurrent painless distal ulcerations and infections leading to osteomyelitis and amputations
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the SPTLC1 or SPTLC2 genes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive distal sensory loss, autonomic dysfunction, and ulcerations plus identification of pathogenic mutation in SPTLC1 or SPTLC2 genes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for confirmation; clinical features overlap with other HSAN types

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal loss of pain and temperature sensation

occasional.symptomName: Gait disturbances due to sensory ataxia

rare.symptomName: Cardiac arrhythmias secondary to autonomic dysfunction
Respiratory complications due to autonomic failure

laboratory: Nerve conduction studies showing reduced sensory nerve action potentials
Skin biopsy demonstrating loss of small myelinated and unmyelinated fibers
imaging: X-rays showing neuropathic joint destruction (Charcot joints)
MRI may show muscle atrophy in distal limbs
other: Autonomic function tests showing impaired sudomotor and cardiovascular reflexes

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly motor and sensory neuropathy with slower progression
Presence of angiokeratomas and renal involvement
Pain crises often present in childhood

redFlags: Rapid progression of sensory loss with severe ulcerations
Signs of systemic autonomic failure such as syncope or arrhythmias
Development of osteomyelitis or gangrene requiring amputation
references: Dyck PJ, et al. Hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathies: clinical features and molecular genetics. Brain. 2011.
Rotthier A, et al. Genes and mechanisms in hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathies. Nat Rev Neurol. 2012.
